name: The Cloud Came Down
description:
They called it a cloud, though it lived behind someone else's doors. Photographs, promises, and entire histories waited inside machines their makers would never see.

The cabinet opens. Its records are carried outward, each finding a place beyond the original enclosure. The old sign rests on the ground. No single door decides who can reach what remains.

attributes.value: Painted steel · ivory housings · frosted acrylic
